title: Why I Love Zoom Calls
content: I love Zoom calls because they give me captive subjects for portraits.This was a meeting of the Advisory Board of the Portrait Society of America. I used casein to paint these little thumbnail doodles of portrait painter Michael Shane Neal........and Executive Director Christine Egnoski.I'll be at theArt of the Portrait Conferencein Washington, DC this May, and recommend you check it out if you're curious.
